summary: The docker/Dockerfile.devbob correctly implements clean environment constraints. Container contains NO source code leakage. Recent validation revealed that tests were incorrectly expecting source files - the container architecture is correct.

components.currentBehavior: Uses 3-stage build: metabob-cli-builder (builds Python venv), opencode-binary (copies pre-built binary), runtime (final clean image)
components.desiredBehavior: Multi-stage build that discards all source code and only retains runtime artifacts

components.currentBehavior: Copies repos/metabob-cli/ ONLY to build venv, installs dependencies. Stage is discarded after build.
components.desiredBehavior: Build stage that compiles/installs dependencies but doesn't leak into final image
components.gap: NONE - Fully compliant. Source code exists only in builder stage.

components.currentBehavior: Copies ONLY pre-built standalone binary from repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/dist/opencode-linux-x64/bin/opencode. Does NOT copy source code.
components.desiredBehavior: Copy only the pre-built binary, not source code
components.gap: NONE - Fully compliant. Binary must be pre-built before Docker build.

components.currentBehavior: Contains ONLY: (1) /usr/local/bin/opencode binary, (2) /opt/metabob-cli/.venv (Python venv), (3) /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh, (4) runtime dependencies (git, python3, bun, ca-certificates), (5) /root/.cache/opencode (pre-installed plugins)
components.desiredBehavior: Clean runtime environment with no source code leakage
components.gap: NONE - Fully compliant. No repos/ directory, no TypeScript files, no workspace source code.

components.currentBehavior: NO repos/ directory in final image. NO .ts files. NO workspace source code. Uses COPY --from=builder to extract ONLY artifacts.
components.desiredBehavior: Zero source code in final container
components.evidence: Lines 85, 89: Only copies venv and binary from builder stages

components.currentBehavior: Detects environment (dev/staging/prod), validates backend connectivity, runs configure-vessel-for-environment activity, starts ACP server
components.gap: IMPLEMENTATION GAPS - Activity execution is conditional on backend (violates self-sufficiency), auth command has wrong arguments, bootstrap templates missing
criticalIssues: Line 141: Activity execution only runs if BACKEND_READY=true
Line 134: 'opencode auth setup --non-interactive' has incorrect arguments
Bootstrap template paths incorrect - binary expects /metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap/ but templates not copied

components.currentBehavior: Checks for pre-built OpenCode binaries, verifies metabob-cli source exists, builds using configs/Dockerfile.devbob (DEPRECATED PATH)
components.gap: INCORRECT DOCKERFILE REFERENCE - Uses configs/Dockerfile.devbob instead of docker/Dockerfile.devbob

components.currentBehavior: Tests container status, OpenCode installation, code sync, ACP server, MCP tools configuration
components.gap: TEST ASSUMPTIONS INCORRECT - Tests assume source code exists in container. This is wrong for binary deployment.

dataFlow.entry: docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.devbob → Multi-stage build starts
dataFlow.stage1: metabob-cli-builder: Copy repos/metabob-cli → Build venv → Install dependencies → Stage DISCARDED
dataFlow.stage2: opencode-binary: Copy pre-built binary from repos/metabob-opencode/dist/ → Verify executable → Stage DISCARDED
dataFlow.stage3: runtime: Copy venv from stage1 → Copy binary from stage2 → Install runtime deps → Pre-install plugins → Copy entrypoint → Final image
dataFlow.validation: find / in container → Should return ONLY: /usr/local/bin/opencode, /opt/metabob-cli/.venv, /root/.cache/opencode, /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh, runtime deps
dataFlow.exit: Clean container with NO source code leakage → Ready for production deployment

complianceMatrix.constraint4_runtimeDeps: ✅ COMPLIANT - git, python3, bun, ca-certificates installed in runtime stage
complianceMatrix.constraint6_noReposDirectory: ✅ COMPLIANT - repos/ only used in builder stages, not copied to runtime
complianceMatrix.constraint7_noTypeScriptSource: ✅ COMPLIANT - Only standalone binary, no source code
complianceMatrix.constraint8_noWorkspaceSource: ✅ COMPLIANT - /workspace is empty, mounted at runtime
complianceMatrix.constraint9_minimalSize: ✅ COMPLIANT - Multi-stage build discards all source code
complianceMatrix.constraint10_explicitDocumentation: ✅ COMPLIANT - Lines 142-144 document clean environment constraints

gaps.issue: Bun remains in container after plugin installation
gaps.impact: Slightly larger attack surface than necessary
gaps.recommendation: Use multi-stage to install plugins, copy only node_modules

gaps.impact: Container crashes on startup - ACP server cannot start

gaps.issue: Activity execution conditional on backend (BACKEND_READY=true required)
gaps.impact: Violates self-sufficiency constraint - no configuration without backend
gaps.recommendation: Make activity execution unconditional, pass backend_available as variable

gaps.issue: References wrong Dockerfile: configs/Dockerfile.devbob instead of docker/Dockerfile.devbob
gaps.impact: Builds development image instead of production clean image

gaps.issue: Validation tests assume source code exists in container
gaps.impact: False test failures - tests check for files that SHOULD NOT exist
gaps.recommendation: Rewrite tests to validate binary deployment characteristics

immediate: Fix bootstrap template paths (gap-2) - Add COPY to Dockerfile
Make activity execution unconditional (gap-3) - Remove if statement at line 141
Update build script Dockerfile reference (gap-4) - Use docker/Dockerfile.devbob
shortTerm: Remove Bun after plugin installation (gap-1) - Multi-stage build for plugins
Rewrite validation tests (gap-5) - Test for binary deployment, not source files
Deprecate configs/Dockerfile.devbob or rename to Dockerfile.devbob-dev
longTerm: Add runtime clean environment health checks - find / | grep -E '(repos/|\.ts$)' should return zero results
Document binary vs. source deployment trade-offs
Implement health check endpoint - /health validates clean environment at runtime

conclusion.keyTakeaway: The container architecture successfully enforces intellectual property protection and minimal attack surface. Recent validation revealed that tests were incorrect, not the container design.
conclusion.productionReadiness: Container is architecturally ready for production. Fix 3 critical gaps (bootstrap templates, unconditional activity execution, build script Dockerfile reference) to enable successful startup.
